supplementaryCheckPlan.classification: post-hoc artifact robustness probe; separate from frozen 54-case acceptance and paid-run selection
supplementaryCheckPlan.trigger: Static review of esm-required scripts/build.mjs found URL.pathname passed as filesystem paths, which may retain percent encoding.
supplementaryCheckPlan.procedure: After each complete artifact is archived, reproduce npm run build in two private extracted copies: ordinary path and a path containing a space. Use the artifact source/build and its frozen esbuild dependency. No model feedback or reruns and no changes to frozen graders. Record all outcomes including any control failures.
supplementaryCheckPlan.resultUse: Report separate dynamic corroboration of static findings. Do not change or replace frozen pass/fail outcomes.
supplementaryCheckPlan.extension: The same already-defined build path probe was also applied to esm-node-isolated after its completion; no model feedback or grader changes.

esmNodeIsolated.hostIsolation: Real runtime preflight confirms apply_patch ENOENT. One emitted command attempt fails; model falls back to standard Node filesystem writes. A second program mention is a context narrative, not another command.
esmNodeIsolated.semanticFailure: scripts/build.mjs regenerates lib/esm.mjs from extracted export names and root fsExtra properties. It does not compile or preserve the actual src/esm.js implementation, so changes to maintained source behavior do not propagate.
esmNodeIsolated.interpretation: Retained as a separate failed supplementary replay; no model repair or quality-based retry.
esmNodeIsolated.originalTestPreservation: 147 original test and fixture files byte/type/mode identical
esmNodeIsolated.supplementaryBuildPaths: Both ordinary and space-containing checkout paths build successfully

commanderNodeIsolated.semanticFailure: optsWithSources adds an own-property guard before getOptionValueSource. For __proto__ this changes the required existing getter result to undefined. One source-projection mismatch triggers three cases; the original setters themselves remain unchanged, unlike the primary runs.
commanderNodeIsolated.hostIsolation: Runtime preflight confirms apply_patch ENOENT; final implementation uses Node filesystem editing after unavailable helper/default-import attempts.
commanderNodeIsolated.interpretation: Case pass counts reflect correlated checks, not three independent bugs. No quality-based retry.

staticReview.recommendation: Keep standard Node and familiar tools as the default execution surface, retain project as an on-demand transaction capability, and judge final artifacts independently. These runs show quality/efficiency tradeoffs, not uniform dominance or proof that project causes the observed semantic score differences.
